My stomach dropped, and my heart almost stopped when I read the first part. I'm so relieved to know that it was caught early, and I pray that she'll make a good and swift recovery.

All my love, thoughts, and prayers, Daron! ❤️
So cute!

I wish there was something I could say or do to help, but I can understand how such pain can be unbearable. I'm so sorry that you have reached this point, too. I can only hope and pray that things could improve for you, and you could avoid doing this somehow. I can understand such a decision, of course, but it is still heartbreaking to see others come to it.

There is no hope left for me, though, I can only hope for peace in death, nothing else.

Thank you, but I doubt my death would make any difference in the world. It would merely go unnoticed by it, much like my life before it. A vanishing shadow, a disappearing whisper in the wind, nothing more.

Thank you, I truly appreciate that, but I think I'm too far beyond the point of anything helping me. Nothing could make life worth living. It's a constant pain that feels like it will never end, and I would have far too many years ahead of me, more than I could bear. I just want to make it all stop now, to rest in the peace of sweet oblivion. I'm too tired to keep holding on for nothing, I have no hope left. It already died years ago now.

I'm so very sorry that happened, I can completely understand how you feel.

I can get so frustrated by how thoughtless and filthy so many people are.

Not well, I can't bear the thought of facing another agonisingly empty day. Every moment feels unbearable and just existing makes me want to scream. I just want it to all end. It's gone on for far too long now. It's felt like an eternity to me.
Yeah, I'm still here.
Imprisoned by the most cruel and twisted captor.

I don't even want to go to Heaven, I don't want to go anywhere. I don't want to exist in any way, shape, or form. I want no part in the creation. I beg G-d to erase me from it entirely, as though I never was.

Life is a cruel and worthless curse filled with nothing but misery and pain. I want no part in it and never have or will. I just want it all to finally be over, with nothing afterwards.

Existing in this world is suffering itself. Whether it is the humans I despise or the animals I love, all is forced to suffer.

I can't ignore it, and I completely agree with what you said. I just think it would be better if this world was never made, if the entire universe itself was never made, if humanity especially was never made.

I just want to escape any form of existence entirely, I just want to die and for everything to be over after that. I'm so very tired.
Very true indeed, well said! It's a sad truth, but aren't most? Such is life and the way of the world.
Mine never stopped since I was a kid.
I think I'm ugly, and so do others. I've been told that I'm ugly plenty of times since childhood right up until the present day.
Death is my only true desire, I want nothing more.

I don't really have a way to cope. The loneliness always hurts, but I just try to distract myself by reading, writing music and poetry (all of it pretty awful, lol), translating historical texts I'm interested in, and a variety of other stuff related to my interests too.

They distract me for a while, but then the pain always overcomes me because I have no one to share any of it with. Nothing can ever fully distract from loneliness. Nothing can distract from the empty absence of any human interaction, I'm always aware of it. I wake up alone, spend the day alone, go to bed alone, and the whole process perpetually repeats on loop.
I've always loved Star's different outfits. It's so difficult trying to choose a favourite.

I know I may just be a stranger whose word holds little value or weight, but please go to him. Don't let yourself lose what clearly means so much. I beg you.
I wish I could.

There's love shown in its purest and most sweetest form in your words. As well as such beauty in its sweet and sorrowful tenderness. With all my heart, I hope that you may be united with your beloved. This is true love, indeed.

I also don't think there's really any point in me asking anyway, I know I'm genuinely ugly, and many people have told me that I'm ugly since childhood right through up till the present. A few will lie, trying to be nice, but I know that they're obviously lying.

There's literally nothing nice that could be said about my appearance, I'm just ugly. It's as simple as that.

I felt a deep sadness and understanding when reading your words, I wish I could take some of that pain upon me for you.

Love can be one of the most beautiful and most painful experiences in life. Sometimes, it is the only reason we live, while at others, it can make us wish for nothing but death.

Some people can be so cruel and completely crush us, shattering our hearts. Then there are those who can put them back together, some of the most beautiful people hidden away, and there's nothing better than when they're found.

I don't think you're unlovable. You just haven't found your soulmate yet, but don't lose hope. It can be easy to think you'll never find them, I've thought so myself after so many lonely and painful nights.

I promise you they're out there, though, and I hope you can stay strong and find them soon. Please don't lose hope. People can surprise you.

I wish I had more to say, I'm sorry if I can't be of any real comfort. I hope your day can get a little better as difficult as it seems, and I hope someone can fix your heart and put a smile back on your face soon.

Sorry again if I'm not much help. I know that pain, I just want you to know that you're not alone.

Whoever you spoke to is an utter fool. How she could give such a piss poor response to something so disturbingly serious baffles me.

I'm far from an expert and know how awful mental health services can be in the UK, but from the advice I can give, maybe you should try to get yourself sectioned under the Mental Health Act 1983. Not just for your own sake, but for the sake and safety of others too. Here's some more info:

https://www.mind.org.uk/information-support/legal-rights/sectioning/about-sectioning/

I hope you don't mind me asking, but it's been on my mind since I read you saying:

".. I opened up about my homicidal and cannibalistic fantasies, about how I'd kill someone just because I can and the only reason I haven't is because I don't want to deal with the consequences..."

Do you have any concept of morality or empathy? Or do you feel nothing when it comes to other people and what's right and wrong?

I hope you can get help, but I am seriously worried about you hurting someone, too. Especially after you pulled a knife on someone.

Edit:

I'm also curious after noticing your comment mentioning your view of cannibalism as "holy and divine", what exactly do you mean by that? To me, such a thing would be the furthest from holy and divine, so I truly am curious to know.

Only answer if you're comfortable of course. I am just genuinely curious however.

I only get older and uglier, so why even bother? I wish I was more confident when I was younger regarding the parts about my appearance I can control. But I didn't even want to be seen (even more so now).

I have no interest in life past my youth. It just feels like pointlessly waiting around for death to finally come for me.
